messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)"
set: ["rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)", "younger than 12 years of age", "children between 12 and 18 years of age with risk factors for breathing problems", "adults and children at least 2 years old with symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis", "erosive esophagitis in adults and children 1 year of age and older", "children younger than 12 years old", "erosive esophagitis caused by acid reflux in adults and children 1 month of age and older", "high blood pressure in children 6 years and older", "symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (gerd) such as heartburn in adults and children 1 year of age and older", "people 65 years of age or older", "anxiety in adults and children at least 7 years old", "major depressive disorder in adults and adolescents at least 12 years old", "asthma attacks in adults and children at least 2 years old", "seasonal allergic rhinitis", "perennial allergic rhinitis", "children under 18 years of age after surgery to remove the tonsils and/or adenoids"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
